terms.comment: Traupman prints bubulus, a slip for būbalus; later the word passed to the buffalo.
Pliny’s northern beast, the reindeer (Lewis & Short, after Cuvier).

sources: Lewis & Short: bubalus · Lewis & Short: tarandrus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 271.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
